rust_compile

matchers/rust/rust_compile/matcher.yaml

id: rust_compile
role: tool
classification: [rust, build]
description: rustc refusing to compile (`error[E0308]`). The first error is usually the cause; later ones often follow from it.
pattern: '^error\[E\d+\]: |^error: (could not compile|aborting due to|linking with)'
after: 8

In bundles

allrust
